name: Australian Finance Group Limited
summary: Australian Finance Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mortgage origination and lending business in Australia. It operates through Distribution and Manufacturing segments. The company is involved in the distribution of home loans, consumer asset finance and commercial loans through AFG broker, as well as residential mortgage lending of own branded home loan products distributed through warehouse facilities and the Group's residential mortgage-backed securities program and white label products.
